counter_note: Final retained task executions only; smoke and superseded infrastructure attempts excluded. Tokens sum API prompt and completion usage, reasoning included once. Responses without usage make the sum a lower bound. Steps count captured upstream function calls, not native agent graph steps. CLI failures remain in the denominator; successful verifiers retain credit. Tool-call counts are also a captured lower bound; transport failures can leave response accounting incomplete.
